name: Rubino (tube type)

origin.basis: Italian bicycle-tire brand; Vittoria's international store is set to Italy (EUR).

manufacturing.basis: The store page does not state where the tire is made.

positioning: Vittoria's everyday training clincher with a Graphene + Silica compound.
weight_basis: Vittoria store weights for black sidewalls; tan is 10 g lighter.

availability.note: Sold by Vittoria's international web store; Rubino tires are sold by Shimano-linked Tmall stores in mainland China; North American availability not verified.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price incl. Italian VAT on 2026-11-01; shipping calculated at checkout. One tire.

caveats: Bicycle Rolling Resistance's 2016 Rubino Pro Speed test is not applied.

image.shown: Rubino render from Vittoria's product page; Vittoria shows the same render for the tube-type and TLR versions, and the construction is not visible.
image.alt: Vittoria Rubino road tire render with red Vittoria sidewall logo

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other. Reviews of the earlier Rubino Pro IV are not counted.

reports.summary: A few months on the 32 mm with an inner tube and nothing negative so far.

checks.note: Listed with a star rating only
Only the earlier Rubino Pro was tested
